## Purpose and scope

## Evidence
- [ ] Typecheck, lint, tests, production build, and single-file build pass
- [ ] Dependency audit reviewed; existing and introduced findings distinguished
- [ ] Regression coverage or reason no new tests are needed
- [ ] Accessibility and browser checks recorded where relevant

## Risk and rollback
Describe data/privacy/security impact, deployment impact, and exact revert path.

## Human review
- [ ] Security, architecture, data, or production-sensitive changes flagged
- [ ] No secrets, production mutations, access changes, or unapproved spending
- [ ] Existing PRs checked for overlap
